name: Street Festival
description: One street is closed to vehicles this shift; letters to that street pay double.

name: Postal Inspector
description: The complaint meter stood at 75 or more at Payday: next shift's earnings are 10% lower.

name: Lost Parcels
description: 5 Lost Parcels worth three times as much lie about the map when Delivery starts, marked from 30 m.

name: Wildfire
description: Wooden walls and belts take 1 damage a second for 60 s unless within 6 m of water.

name: Overtime
description: A quota missed by 10% or less: Delivery runs 60 s longer, once a run; cover the shortfall and the run goes on.

name: Neighbourhood Watch
description: No misdelivery this shift: +25% of the shift's earnings at Payday.

name: Mega Migration
description: Megas come three times as often this shift, and every Mega drops 2 Lost Parcels.

name: Bulk Drop
description: A Cargo item for every open Business Dock arrives at the Intake at once, worth half again.
